create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetRulesForRerun] ( @ruleId int null ) as begin
declare @ruleIds table (id int)
if @ruleId is null begin insert into @ruleIds select ID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule end else begin insert into @ruleIds select @ruleId end
--find all field updates on when conditions declare @fieldUpdates table (FieldTypeID int, ResponsibilityRuleId int, MaxDate datetime) insert into @fieldUpdates (FieldTypeID, ResponsibilityRuleId) select WF.FieldTypeID, R.ID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule R cross apply OPENJSON(R.Definition, '$.When') D cross apply OPENJSON(D.value) with ( CheckType nvarchar(1) '$.CheckType', FieldTypeID int '$.FieldTypeID' ) WF where WF.CheckType = 'F' and R.ID in (select id from @ruleIds)
--find all field updates on then conditions insert into @fieldUpdates (FieldTypeID, ResponsibilityRuleId) select WF.FieldTypeID, R.ID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule R cross apply OPENJSON(R.Definition, '$.Then.Conditions') D cross apply OPENJSON(D.value) with ( FieldTypeID int '$.FieldTypeID' ) WF where WF.FieldTypeID is not null and R.ID in (select id from @ruleIds)
drop table if exists #fieldTypeUpdatesMap ;with cte as (select distinct FieldTypeId from @fieldUpdates) select * into #fieldTypeUpdatesMap from cte outer apply (select MAX(F.UpdatedOn) from Field F where F.FieldTypeID = cte.FieldTypeID)MaxDate(UpdatedOn)
merge @fieldUpdates as target using (select * from #fieldTypeUpdatesMap)source on source.FieldTypeId = target.FieldTypeId when matched then update set MaxDate = source.UpdatedOn;
--find all relationship updates declare @relationshipUpdates table (IntersectTypeID int, ResponsibilityRuleId int, MaxDate datetime) insert into @relationshipUpdates (IntersectTypeID, ResponsibilityRuleId) select WF.IntersectTypeID, R.ID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule R cross apply OPENJSON(R.Definition, '$.When') D cross apply OPENJSON(D.value) with ( CheckType nvarchar(1) '$.CheckType', IntersectTypeID int '$.IntersectTypeID'
) WF where WF.CheckType = 'R' and R.ID in (select id from @ruleIds)
drop table if exists #relationshipUpdatesMap ;with cte as (select distinct IntersectTypeID from @relationshipUpdates) select * into #relationshipUpdatesMap from cte outer apply (select MAX(I.UpdatedOn) from [Intersect] I where I.IntersectTypeID = cte.IntersectTypeID)MaxDate(UpdatedOn)
merge @relationshipUpdates as target using (select * from #relationshipUpdatesMap)source on source.IntersectTypeID = target.IntersectTypeID when matched then update set MaxDate = source.UpdatedOn;
select RTRR.* from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule RTRR inner join AssetType AT on AT.Object = RTRR.Object AND AT.ObjectID = RTRR.ObjectID outer apply (select case when RTRR.UpdatedOn > coalesce(RTRR.LastRunOn, '1/1/2000') then 1 else 0 end as Value)WasRuleUpdated outer apply (select IIF(count(1) > 0, 1, 0) from reporting.Global_Resource where CreatedOn > coalesce(RTRR.LastRunOn, '1/1/2000'))HasNewUsers(Value) outer apply (select max(A.CreatedOn), max(A.UpdatedOn) from Asset A Where AssetTypeID = AT.Id)AssetMax(AssetMaxCreatedOn, AssetMaxUpdatedOn) outer apply (select max(MaxDate) from @fieldUpdates where ResponsibilityRuleId = RTRR.ID)AssetFieldMaxDate(Value) outer apply (select max(MaxDate) from @relationshipUpdates where ResponsibilityRuleId = RTRR.ID)IntersectMaxDate(Value) outer apply OPENJSON(RTRR.Definition, '$.Then') WITH ([Object] varchar(20), ObjectID int) as ThenCondition outer apply (select g.UpdatedOn from [group] g where g.id = ThenCondition.ObjectId and ThenCondition.Object = 'GroupType')GroupUpdated(Value) outer apply ( SELECT MAX(D) FROM (VALUES (AssetMax.AssetMaxCreatedOn), (AssetMax.AssetMaxUpdatedOn), (AssetFieldMaxDate.Value), (IntersectMaxDate.Value),(GroupUpdated.Value)) AS RelevantUpdateDates(D))AggregatedDates(MaxDate) where rtrr.ID in (select id from @ruleIds) and ISNULL(ThenCondition.Object,'') <> 'OrganizationType' and (WasRuleUpdated.Value = 1 or HasNewUsers.Value = 1 or AggregatedDates.MaxDate > coalesce(RTRR.LastRunOn, '1/1/2000')) option(recompile)
end
